**Hint 1:** Consider the role of the regularization term (λ) in the model. Regularization helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. When choosing λ, you want to balance the model's complexity with its ability to generalize well to unseen data.

**Hint 2:** Look at the errors provided for each λ value across the cross-validation folds. The goal is to select the λ that results in the lowest validation error, indicating the best generalization performance. Remember that the training and validation sets are consistent across all choices of λ, so you can directly compare the errors.
